name: San Carlos
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

notes: Uco Valley wines are deep in color, intense in aroma and rich in flavor.

blurb.text: A wine area in Mendoza, with Cordón el Cepillo, La Consulta, Pampa el Cepillo and Paraje Altamira inside. Malbec dominates the plantings.
